headline_drivers: Q1 2026 results: revenue $188m (+31% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA up 21%, reinforcing a strong growth/margin trajectory despite a wider net loss of ~$55m (earnings release and coverage 2026-05-16–18)

Major guidance raise tied to closing of Legend acquisition: 2026 revenue outlook lifted from $810–820m to $990m–$1.01b and 2026 adjusted EBITDA from $180–190m to $270–280m, implying a higher 28% EBITDA margin vs prior ~23% (Legend deal close and outlook update mid‑May 2026)

Longer-term narrative re‑rated by analysts/stock sites: scenarios now highlighting $1.2b revenue and ~$165–230m earnings by 2029 and fair value estimates around $11–12 per share, implying 150%+ upside from pre‑move levels (Simply Wall St / SahmCapital / Public.com notes mid‑May 2026)

Retail- and quant-driven follow‑through: GENI now screens on top‑5d performance and gapper/volume spike lists, with RSI in the 90th+ percentile and only modest volume vs 10‑day average (~1.05x), consistent with momentum/technical chasing on top of the fundamental re‑rating
summary: The recent 20–30% multi-week move in GENI is primarily a fundamental re‑rating around the Q1 2026 print and, more importantly, the much higher 2026 guidance issued after closing the Legend acquisition. Management is now guiding to nearly $1.0b in 2026 revenue and $270–280m in adjusted EBITDA (28% margin), versus prior $810–820m and $180–190m (~23% margin), which has led analysts and platforms to frame upside scenarios of $1.2–1.3b revenue and solid profitability by 2029 and price targets around $10–12+. With that step‑change in scale/margins established, the stock has then been pulled into momentum/technical screens (top‑5d, gapper) and bought by growth and retail traders, amplifying the move despite only modestly higher volume.
